messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-96321 fired — p99 latency 2.3s on /v1/generate (service: inference-hosting). Trigger: canary rollout v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2 at us-west-2.
mae.sre: acked. i'm on it. grabbing logs and canary ids.
sam.frontend: thx. seeing 5xxs from edge in metrics? dashboard link: https://grafana/reports/abc
jordan.platform: copying deploy diff: commit abc123 -> def456. new kernel optimizations + kvcache change.
olivia.eng: pulling pods in canary namespace: `kubectl -n prod-canary get pods -l app=inference` — some pods in CrashLoopBackOff
mae.sre: grabbing recent logs
mae.sre: ```
2026-03-15T01:12:30Z inference[def456] ERROR kv_cache_init: failed to mmap
2026-03-15T01:12:31Z inference[def456] WARN fallback to sync io
2026-03-15T01:12:35Z inference[def456] ERROR runtime OOM allocating 512MB
```
sam.frontend: customers seeing increased 5xx, but error budget not burnt yet. majority in region us-west-2
jordan.platform: rolling back canary? we can rollback the ReplicaSet to v2.3.1 quickly: `kubectl -n prod-rollout rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=2`
olivia.eng: can we divert traffic back to stable while rollback proceeds? we have traffic-split rule in envoy: `route->stable:90 canary:10`
mae.sre: propose pause rollout and shift to stable 100% for affected routes. I'll flip the traffic-split to stable:100
oncall-rota: i'm taking handoff. will coordinate with infra to perform rollback if necessary. pinging infra.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty PD-96321 acknowledged by mae.sre at 2026-03-15T01:13:02Z
infra: infra here. prepared rollback playbook. will hold until traffic shift completes.
mae.sre: changed route: `envoy config set route inference -> stable 100` — waiting for propagation (expected 15s)
sam.frontend: seeing drop in 5xxs in the edge; p95 latency back to normal in 30s
olivia.eng: pods in canary still OOMing, but new traffic hitting stable now. mitigation working.
mae.sre: starting rollback to be safe. executing:
```
kubectl -n prod-rollout rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=2
kubectl -n prod-canary delete pods -l release=canary --grace-period=30
```
jordan.platform: keeping canary logs for postmortem, don't truncate.
mae.sre: rollback succeeded. new deployment state: stable replicas 40, canary 0
oncall-rota: updating incident ticket -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026
oncall-rota: ETA for full verification 10m. will monitor.
sam.frontend: customer impact: approx 1.8% of requests returning 5xx during the 3m window. flagging support to reach out if needed.
mae.sre: adding notes: root cause suspected mem mapping change in kvcache codepath on certain kernels; assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime for follow-up.
olivia.eng: filing follow-up bug: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-857
jordan.platform: adding rollback artifacts and commands to runbook. will pin canary images until fix.
mae.sre: incident severity set to sev2 (partial outage for small % of traffic). pagerduty: escalate policy disabled for now.
pagerduty-bot: PD-96321 resolved by mae.sre at 2026-03-15T01:22:30Z — incident closed after rollback and verification. :white_check_mark:
oncall-rota: handed back to daytime oncall @june.sre in 30m for follow-up work. will create postmortem.
mae.sre: any other asks? otherwise i'll mark thread as monitoring and close after hour if stable.
sam.frontend: nope. monitoring looks clean. thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived to incidents after 7 days. Include postmortem link when available.
